stories.title: Shotton Mill director joins new business board advising on North Wales economy
stories.summary: Jackie Pearson is one of nine members of Ambition North Wales' Business Advisory Board, which will advise on the Growth Deal and the Flintshire and Wrexham Investment Zone.

stories.title: Councillor asks if Flintshire is “flogging a dead horse” with Warren Hall tax site
stories.summary: A Flintshire councillor has asked whether the council is “flogging a dead horse” with Warren Hall in Broughton, a site where firms could get up to five years free of business rates. stories.title: Asda cuts unleaded to 159.7p at Queensferry as supermarket takes 4p a litre off fuel
stories.summary: Asda has cut unleaded to 159.7p a litre at its Queensferry forecourt, the second cheapest petrol in Flintshire on Deeside.com’s fuel price tracker. stories.title: Therapy farm near Holywell plans holiday pods for families affected by autism and disabilities
stories.summary: Three glamping pods are planned for a farm between Holywell and Greenfield that provides horse and animal therapy for people with autism, learning disabilities and anxiety. stories.title: Springfield Hotel gym plan approved by Flintshire County Council
stories.summary: The Springfield Hotel in Pentre Halkyn can turn a four-bedroom bungalow in its grounds into an extra fitness studio after Flintshire County Council approved the plans.
